title: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 1994
SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XIV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-13/94, dated
25-7-1994.--The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Bills, 1994 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 25th June, 1994 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st July, 1994 is hereby published as Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act ( of 1989)

ACT XIV OF 1994
SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XIV OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-13/94, dated
25-7-1994.--The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Bills, 1994 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 25th June, 1994 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st July, 1994 is hereby published as Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act ( of 1989).- In the Sindh
Public Service Commission Act, 1989, after section 5, the following new section
shall be inserted:--
"5.A.
Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, Government may, not later than
31st July, 1994, curtail the term of office of the Chairman or any Member
appointed before the c9ming into force of this section."
